name: process-capability-analyzer
description: SPC, process capability and Gage R&R for manufacturing: X-bar/R, X-bar/S and I-MR charts with Western Electric and Nelson rules, Cp/Cpk vs Pp/Ppk kept distinct, crossed Gage R&R (ANOVA and AIAG Average & Range). Verified against published results.

paragraphs: Try it live -> spc-analyzer.streamlit.app — no install. The Gage R&R page opens on the AIAG reference study and reproduces Minitab's published results without any input.

Free, open-source statistics for the three questions a supplier answers before shipping a new part: is the gauge good enough (Gage R&R), is the process stable (SPC charts), and is it capable (Cp/Cpk vs Pp/Ppk). Every method is checked against published results, and every output is a defensible engineering statement, not just a chart:
"Cpk = 1.09 from within-subgroup sigma, but the individuals chart shows an N1 outlier and an N2 run — this Cpk is not trustworthy evidence of future performance until the process is stabilized."
features: Gage R&R (crossed): ANOVA (random-effects F tests, interaction pooled at

p > 0.25 by convention) and the AIAG Average & Range method. Reports EV, AV, interaction, GRR, PV, %Contribution, %Study Var, %Tolerance (k = 6 or 5.15) and ndc. A range chart checks repeat readings before anything is…
Control charts: X̄–R, X̄–S, and I–MR with proper 3σ limits from the
published control-chart constants (never plain ±3·stdev of the plotted data).

(8 rules) sets, kept distinct (WE4 = 8-in-a-row ≠ Nelson N2 = 9-in-a-row), with structured violations: rule ID, name, affected observations, direction, explanation. Overlapping violations are preserved.
